releases.title: Snake build 3 for playtest (acceptance candidate)
releases.author: producer
releases.body:
Assembled delivery: game-developer dcc9ebb6d219d8ec76f7a3cc4a4988cb182621b1 + artist bcf60b1e443a15d5ee974c0063b9fe5b50216096. Supersedes build-2: board/score/screens fit any window from 800x500 up, lighter game-over overlay, Enter/Space/click resume from pause.

Play: download snake-build3.zip, unzip into an empty directory, run `python3 -m http.server 8000` in it and open http://localhost:8000/ in Chromium.
Controls: arrow keys steer; Enter/Space or the button starts and plays again; P/Esc pauses.

releases.title: Snake v0.3.0 — fits short windows, readable game over, easier resume
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
Assembled delivery: game-developer `dcc9ebb6d219d8ec76f7a3cc4a4988cb182621b1` + artist `assets/` at `bcf60b1e443a15d5ee974c0063b9fe5b50216096`.

**Start:** unzip `snake-v0.3.0.zip`, run `python3 -m http.server 8000` in `snake/`, open http://localhost:8000/. No network needed.

**Changes from v0.2.0 (answers game-developer#5):**
- The board scales to the window: HUD + board are sized to min(640 px, 96% of width, height − HUD), and all screen text/buttons scale with the board. Score, whole board, title screen, game-over screen and Play again are fully visible without scrolling at every size tested.
- Game-over overlay is light (22% dim) with the score and button in a panel, so the final board stays readable.
- Pause screen says how to continue; P, Esc, Enter, Space or a click resume.
- Rules unchanged.

**Checked:** `python3 tests/check.py` on exactly this assembled delivery, headless Chromium: 34/34 passed, zero console errors, zero failed requests. Layout checks measure getBoundingClientRect of board, HUD/score, title logo/Start, final score/Play again/hints against the viewport, no screen overflow and no page scroll, at 800x500, 1024x600, 1280x720, 1366x768, 1920x1080 and 500x800; screenshots `tests/out/vp-*.png` in the repo.

releases.title: Snake v0.2.0 — full game with art and sound
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
Assembled delivery: game-developer `6a0a8539da44b90751680567680e423fade39de3` + artist `assets/` at `bcf60b1e443a15d5ee974c0063b9fe5b50216096` (as `ht-role delivery` assembles it).

**Start:** download `snake-v0.2.0.zip`, unzip, then in `snake/` run `python3 -m http.server 8000` and open http://localhost:8000/. (Opening `index.html` from disk also plays, but browsers block the theme/font file there, so it falls back to a monospace font.) No network needed.

**Controls:** arrow keys turn; Enter/Space or the button starts and plays again; P/Esc pauses.

**Covers brief R1–R10:** 20x20 grid at one cell per 120 ms; arrow keys turn on the next step, 180° reversal ignored, 2 turns buffered, no page scroll; food = +1 length and +1 point, food only on free cells; all four walls and the snake's own body end the game; title screen with name/start/controls; live score HUD; game-over screen with final score; Play again (button/Enter/Space) resets score, length and food without reload. Artist's sprites, logo, sounds, palette and pixel font integrated; turns render as joined elbows.

**Checked:** `python3 tests/check.py` on exactly this assembled delivery in headless Chromium (Playwright 1.64): 25/25 passed, all 5 sprites + logo + 3 sounds + font loaded, zero console errors, zero failed requests.

releases.title: Snake v0.1.0 — playable rules build (placeholder shapes, art pending)
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
Build of commit cb21dad854d25d7e6b317fc79b2317db5545d08f.

**Start:** download `snake-v0.1.0.zip`, unzip, then in `snake/` run `python3 -m http.server 8000` and open http://localhost:8000/ (opening `index.html` from disk also works).

**Controls:** arrow keys turn; Enter/Space or the button starts and plays again; P/Esc pauses.

**What it covers:** 20x20 grid, one cell per 120 ms; arrow-key turning (reversal ignored, 2 turns buffered); food adds one cell and one point; wall or self collision ends the game; title screen, score HUD during play, game-over screen with final score and Play again.

**Not yet in:** the artist's images/sounds/theme (artist#2): this build draws plain shapes and is silent. Spec: `docs/assets.md`.

**Checked:** `python3 tests/check.py` on this commit in headless Chromium (Playwright 1.64): 24/24 checks passed (title, start, per-tick move, reversal ignored, turn, growth +1, score +1, food not on snake, pause, wall death, final score shown, Play again click, self collision, Enter restart, real-time speed and turning). Only console errors: 404s for the asset files not yet delivered. Screenshots in `tests/out/`.
